phrase.zh: 星光从云气里慢慢生长。

visual.zh: 发亮的团块悬在层叠的气体与尘埃之间，表现恒星诞生的环境。色彩和位置并非某一星云的观测图。
visual.en: Bright knots sit within layered gas and dust to suggest a birthplace of stars. Colors and positions do not depict an observed nebula.

background.zh: 恒星在寒冷的分子云中形成；局部气体与尘埃在引力作用下聚集、收缩，逐步孕育原恒星。恒星形成涉及许多阶段，不能从这张画判断其年龄或质量。
background.en: Stars form in cold molecular clouds as pockets of gas and dust gather and collapse under gravity, leading toward protostars. The process has many stages; this illustration cannot reveal an age or mass.
